results.title: Addicted to Change
results.overview: In a near future Britain, at a biotech lab on the brink of collapse, three interns invent a cognitive enhancing drug. They begin full scale manufacture, only to become targets of government forces who view their breakthrough as a threat.

results.title: Seeni
results.overview: A young woman and her family find their lives turned upside down when a series of unexpected and mysterious events begin unfolding around them, leading them into a situation far beyond anything they could have imagined.

results.title: POSSESSION: The Darkness Within
results.overview: Odysseas Zervas, a grieving painter plagued by visions, confronts a sinister figure who mirrors his fears. As reality dissolves, his family seeks help, while a monk races to save him from a spiritual force that claims both sanity and soul.

results.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 3
results.overview: The third night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 19, 2026, at Hokkaido Prefectural Sports Center in Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between Zack Sabre Jr. and Yuya Uemura.

results.title: NJPW Best of the Super Junior 33 - Day 1
results.original_title: NJPW Best of the Super Junior 33 - Day 1
results.overview: The opening night of New Japan Pro Wrestling's annual junior heavyweight round-robin tournament took place on May 14, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: Campeón Gabacho
results.overview: Liborio, an endearing and mischievous young migrant whose only talent is taking punches. He crosses the Rio Grande to escape a harsh reality in Mexico, looking for a better life in the United States, and settles in a Latino barrio in New York City. Through his fists, his love, and his words, he faces cultural walls and prejudices that threaten his hopes, and becomes a hero in an unknown land.

results.title: Extra Geography
results.overview: In an English girls boarding school, two teenage best friends grapple with the challenges of girlhood — friendship, boys, studies, and growing up — and embark on their school project, falling in love.

results.title: Fini de rire !
results.overview: In France, laughing at the powerful has become a risky business. Over the past thirty years, the country’s most outspoken comedians on television and radio have been systematically silenced, sidelined, censored, or even fired. In public broadcasting as in the private media, the same pattern keeps repeating itself: satire is tolerated as long as it doesn’t bite. The moment it takes aim at those in power, the microphone is switched off.  From the sets of Canal+ to the studios of France Inter, through the corridors of France Télévisions, and from the presidency of Nicolas Sarkozy to that of Emmanuel Macron, this documentary traces the mechanisms of a systematic silencing—one that reveals much about the true state of freedom of expression in French broadcasting.

results.title: Babystar
results.overview: Luca is an influencer. For as long as she can remember, she has been the star of her parents' family social media business and their only pride and joy. When her parents decide to have another child, things change. Luca feels betrayed and is afraid of no longer being needed by her parents, whose attention remains tied to her performance for the family account.

results.title: Rotten
results.overview: A woman living with the pain of a rotten tooth plans to spend savings on a dentist appointment. But an unexpected afternoon with her boss's wife draws her into a world she cannot afford.

results.title: 10th 'B'
results.overview: Two best friends from Class 10-B reunite at their old school after years apart. As they revisit bittersweet memories and reflect on the reasons they lost touch, they begin to rediscover the bond they once shared.

results.title: Tandem
results.overview: When two strangers cross paths biking through Raleigh, NC, their chance encounter sparks a romance that changes them both forever.

results.title: The Bachelorette Party
results.overview: A bachelorette getaway turns deadly when persistent tensions ignite chilling threats.

results.title: Weedkiller
results.overview: Weedkiller is a Welsh B-movie and indie SOV horror feature written and directed by filmmaker Tom Hughes. The film follows a humble gardener who goes on a violent rampage to rescue his beloved plants after a gang hijacks his allotment. The movie, described as a genre banger packed with chaos and attitude, draws inspiration from campy classics like The Toxic Avenger.

results.title: Famous Last Words: Eric Dane
results.overview: In this emotional interview, the late actor and ALS advocate Eric Dane shared his final message for the world — knowing it would not air until his death.

results.title: Gummy
results.overview: A serial killer goes out one night in search of a new victim and ends up encountering his worst nightmare.

results.title: Kidnapping My Own Daughter
results.overview: A devoted CPS worker and her family are taken hostage by two desperate parents searching for their wrongfully removed child, exposing a cover-up that threatens her career--and life.

results.title: House of the Wind
results.overview: Josette (80) lives alone in Yaoundé, Cameroon. All her children have left for the West. She encourages them to build houses in Cameroon, a ploy to bring them back to her. But the unexpected bond she forms with Sarah, a young woman from her neighborhood, shatters everything she has built her life on: her family, her responsibilities, and her hopes.

results.title: Rambut Sewu: Satu Langkah Getih
results.overview: Wulan moves to a village with her mother, Ratih. After working at a tea factory, they move into an old house owned by the company. From then on, Wulan begins to experience strange dreams and mysterious events, eventually losing control of herself. The villagers attribute these disturbances to Marni, a former resident of the house whose story has remained a mystery for decades. When Wulan’s story spreads on social media, Damar, a reporter and native son of the village, arrives to investigate. Suradi, who is aware of the powers of the past, comes to help. Together, they try to sever Wulan’s connection to Marni and the power of Dhandhang Gendhing.
